message:
The other day, we found ourselves in one of those unexpected weather alerts that make us realize we might not be as prepared as we think. Our family group chat lit up with messages—"Do we have enough water?" "Where did we put the go-bags?" and the classic, "What’s the plan if the power goes out?" It was a bit chaotic, but honestly, it made me smile. 

It reminded me that preparedness isn’t just about supplies; it’s about communication and teamwork. We might not have all the answers right away, but sharing our thoughts and plans together makes us stronger. 

How often do we check in on our readiness as a family? 🏠
